title: Commercial Applications
description: Commercial Applications (Group III) for ICSE Examination Years 2027 and 2028: markets and marketing, finance, human resources and public relations.

syllabusBaselines.source: CISCE Research, Development and Curriculum Division, Commercial Applications syllabus, Examination Year 2028 (reproduced); cross-checked against the Oswal and Shaalaa 2026-27 listings for the same four units.
syllabusBaselines.note: Verified October 2026. Four prescribed units. A 2-hour written paper of 100 raw marks with 100 raw marks of internal assessment (at least four assignments), carried on a 50% external / 50% internal basis as a Group III subject.

sections.title: Commercial Applications
sections.description: Four units: markets and marketing, finance, human resources and public relations.

groups.title: Understanding the basics of Markets and Marketing

chapters.title: Markets and Marketing
chapters.blurb: What markets and marketing are, the stages of marketing, the types of market and the difference between a product and a service.

chapters.title: The Marketing Mix and Pricing
chapters.blurb: Product, price, place and promotion, the product life cycle and the pricing strategies a firm chooses between.

chapters.title: Advertising and Brand Promotion
chapters.blurb: Advertising media and their advantages, sales promotion, branding, brand loyalty and how publicity differs.

chapters.title: Sales and the Selling Process
chapters.blurb: Marketing against selling, the steps of the selling process, personal selling and the qualities of a good salesman.

chapters.title: Accounting Fundamentals
chapters.blurb: The GAAP concepts of entity, duality, matching, money measurement and going concern, and the three financial statements.

chapters.title: Banking
chapters.blurb: Central bank against commercial bank, the types of account, cheque and draft instruments, ATM use and cheque refusal.

chapters.title: Cost Concepts
chapters.blurb: Direct and indirect cost, fixed, variable and semi-variable cost, and reading them in an ordinary business decision.

chapters.title: Human Resource Management
chapters.blurb: What a human resource is, the features, role and functions of human resource management in a commercial organisation.

chapters.title: Recruitment, Selection and Training
chapters.blurb: Internal and external sources, direct and indirect recruitment, selection and interviews, and on-the-job and off-the-job training.

chapters.title: Public Relations
chapters.blurb: The meaning, nature, scope and elements of public relations, its history and its ethics.

chapters.title: Issues of the Environment
chapters.blurb: Resource depletion, greenhouse effect, pollution and its disasters, consumer education and community programmes such as Chipko.
